Join Boix Maquinaria as an International Service Technician, preparing, installing, and maintaining machinery for customers across Australia and New Zealand. •	Collaborate with the wider service team to ensure high-quality, consistent service delivery.

We are seeking talented individuals to join our External Audit practise at KPMG.  We are open to full-time/part-time/casual/max-term/flexible working options.

IT External Audit
Our IT External Audit team assists our clients to meet their IT External audit requirements and timelines. We work as an integrated business and as part of a larger multi-disciplinary team. The team draws on a diverse and dedicated group of people, powerful KPMG methodologies, innovating capability and assets, and global resources to support our clients in achieving the right milestones. 

Audit & Assurance: External Audit
Our Audit teams provide value to our clients by delivering specialised quality audit and assurance services. High-quality, independent financial statement audits are essential to maintaining investor confidence. Our audit professionals are committed to the public interest, challenging assumptions, and unlocking valuable insights based on a solid understanding of an organisation’s business and industry.

How are you extraordinary?
•	You are analytically minded and enjoy applying structured thinking and analysis techniques to complex problems. 
•	You are a kind and compassionate leader with a passion for continually growing your leadership skills to get the best out of a diverse and multidisciplinary team.
•	You are a people-person with a love of sharing your Audit and Assurance insight and tailoring your communication appropriately for subject matter experts and clients who want to learn more.

Your Experience
To be considered for this opportunity, your qualifications, skills & experience could include:

IT External Audit
•	Experience in assisting clients meet their IT External audit requirements and timelines.
•	Supporting engagements in the preparation of clear and concise IT External Audit reports. 
•	Providing technical knowledge, direction, and training to engagement team members.

Service Coordinator - Scheduling & Operations Focus
Part-time | Canberra-based | Customer & technician coordination

About us
We are a proudly local, family-owned electrical & technology services company in Canberra. We deliver end-to-end solutions across electrical, solar, security, air conditioning, and data.

Our reputation is built on reliability, communication, and getting jobs done properly the first time. We work across residential and commercial clients and maintain long-term relationships through consistent delivery.

We run a structured, systems-driven operation using Simpro for job management and simple SOPs to keep everything moving. As we grow, we need someone who can take ownership of the day-to-day coordination of jobs and keep the business flowing efficiently.

The role
This is a hands-on coordination role focused on scheduling, responsiveness, and keeping technicians productive.

You’ll be responsible for ensuring work is booked, planned, and executed efficiently while maintaining a high level of communication with customers.

1) Scheduling & workflow control
Own the daily schedule and ensure technicians are fully allocated
Book jobs and quote visits as soon as enquiries come in
Plan upcoming work to minimise downtime and maximise productivity
Confirm job details, access, materials, and notes ahead of each day
Adjust schedules in real time as priorities change
Ensure all jobs are kept moving and nothing sits idle

2) Customer communication
Manage inbound enquiries (phone, email, website) and respond promptly
Book new work quickly and professionally
Confirm appointments and keep customers updated
Ensure a high standard of communication across all touchpoints

3) Technician support & coordination
Work closely with technicians to keep jobs running smoothly
Assist with procurement, job preparation, and resolving issues
Provide clear job information, notes, and updates through Simpro
Escalate issues early and help keep projects moving

4) Systems & admin
Manage jobs and workflow primarily through Simpro
Maintain a controlled inbox and respond without delay
Use Office 365 (Outlook, Teams), SharePoint, and HubSpot CRM
Assist with invoice preparation and job close-out
Maintain clean and consistent job records and processes
Create, maintain, and improve SOPs and documented processes to support consistent workflow and operations

About you
Proven experience in scheduling or coordinating field staff (trade or service business highly regarded)
Strong organisational skills and ability to manage multiple jobs at once
Confident communicator with a focus on fast, clear responses
Comfortable working across multiple systems (Simpro experience highly regarded)
Experience with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, or CRM systems (e.g. HubSpot)
Proactive and able to work without constant direction
Based in Canberra and available to work from the office

Hours & flexibility
3 days per week (approximately 6 hours per day)
Designed to suit school hours
Initial in-person training, then a hybrid working arrangement
Flexible start and finish times within the middle of the day

Pay
$35-40 per hour + super, based on experience

Employer questions
Your application will include the following questions:
How many years' experience do you have as a service coordinator?
Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
Do you have experience using Xero?
Which of the following Microsoft Office products are you experienced with?
How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
Do you have a current Police Check (National Police Certificate) for employment?
Do you own or have regular access to a car?

result.description:
Just Better Care Eastern Suburbs 

Full-Time Disabilities Services Officer (Multiple positions) 

About us:
Just Better Care provides in-home disability and aged care services, supporting people to live independently. We believe people of all ages & all abilities deserve access to the support and resources they need in order to live where they want and how they want. At Just Better Care, we CARE about our customers and our team. Our office covers four territories in the Sydney Metro area; Eastern Suburbs, Inner West, Sutherland and St George.
Just Better Care Eastern Suburb is looking for Disabilities Services Officer to join our caring and dynamic team. This role involves working with customers to support them in many different aspects of their day-to-day life. The role involves supporting customers with mental, physical, social and emotional disabilities. Support is provided in a manner that maintains the customer’s independence, is respectful and safe.

Main responsibility
•	Demonstrate a commitment to best practice, ensuring that all services are provided in a caring and respectful way in accordance with Just Better Care’s policy and procedures.
•	Assisting clients in showering, dressing, grooming, manual transfers and hoist assisted.
•	Social support/transportation: social activities, shopping/groceries, travelling to medical appointments
•	Clinical support: medication assistance, catheter, bowel care, enteral feeding,
•	Supporting customers in the use of aids and personal equipment including: standing or walking frames, wheelchairs, manual or electric hoists, sliding sheets or moving boards, hearing aids and other physical aids
•	Supporting customers with complex and/or challenging behaviours
•	Monitoring the well-being of customers and reporting on their progress
•	Providing a safe environment for the client by monitoring their surroundings for potential dangers such as fire hazards and tripping hazards.
•	Supporting clients socially and arranging visits or outings in the community.
•	Ensuring that all documentation is completed in a timely and accurate manner. Where offices are using Mobility Options, community support workers are required to use the application for all schedule visits as per their training.
•	Attending and participating in staff meetings and training sessions as directed by the Coordinator.
•	Ensuring that all responsible steps are taken to protect personal safety at work and avoid adversely affecting the health or safety of any other person at the workplace in accordance with requirements under the Work Health and Safety legalisation.
•	Participating in activities aimed at the continuous improvement of services.
•	Complying with Just Better Care’s Vision, Values, and Purpose

What you will need:
•	Qualification in the relevant field.
•	At least 2 years’ relevant work experience.
•	NDIS Workers Check or Police Clearance
•	Current Australian Drivers Licence
•	Current First Aid and CPR certificates
•	Ability to be contacted by either telephone or email
•	Ability or willingness to assist or work with customer in daily living and personal care skills
•	Be reliable & productive
•	Valuing attitudes towards customers
•	Ability to work as part of a Team and maintain good working relationships
•	Commitment to self-improvement
•	Good written and verbal skills in English

Salary Range: $80,000 to 90,000 per annum excluding superannuation.
Why Join Us: 
•	Close-knit team of friendly, helpful and supportive people.
•	Career development and training opportunities are very high on our priority list.
•	We have a vested interest in you, hence you will be well supported.
•	A competitive salary is on offer for the right candidate.
•	Employee Assistance Programme.
If you have any questions or would like to know more about the role, send an e-mail to hr.es@justbettercare.com

We are looking for a competent individual to fill the role of a Service/Installer Assistant on a permanent, full-time basis. Working out of our Hobart office, the successful incumbent will need to possess the following;

Duties:
Maintain a friendly, co-operative, customer-focused attitude at all times with emphasis on portraying willingness to help
Ensure that the quality of service and installation meets the company’s required standards as defined
Assist the installers in their responsibility for prompt follow-through of customer feed-back on all service or installation issues that fall into the scope of this role
Advise Management of any customer complaints
Assist installers in carrying out high quality installations in a professional and safe manner whilst being courteous and polite at all times
Project Adjustment on site if needed, communicate the adjustments to the branch
Follow all WH&S guidelines and procedures and inform HR of any hazards or incidents relating to your duties and your own safety
On completion of job ensure work area is left in a clean and tidy manner as was on arrival
Avoid damage to products where possible. Advise the branch immediately of any accidents or damage to any persons or property
Perform other reasonable duties as required by your manager.

Have a level of skill commensurate with 3 to 5 years of Industry experience.
Hold a current valid driver’s license
Requires strong technical and problem solving skills, and setting of priorities.
Required to exercise good time management
Requires interpersonal skills
Should possess sound coordination and communication skills,
Computer skills are essential.
